verdict.rationale: Claude Design runs multi-step, cross-app workflows such as Salesforce-to-PDF and QuickBooks/Canva/HubSpot campaigns, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no version history, diffing, review workflow, or rollback for automations or designs. Inline comments and group editing cover collaborative design refinement, not versioned automation review.
